newsitem.title: UK: No BA Euro flights from Gatwick till 1300GMT.
newsitem.headline: No BA Euro flights from Gatwick till 1300GMT.

text.p: All European flights by British Airways Plc from London's Gatwick airport have been stopped until 1300 GMT following a security alert, a spokeswoman for the airport said on Monday.
No long haul flight by British Airways will take off until 1115 GMT. Flights are still landing at Gatwick, south of London, but nothing has taken off since around 0630 GMT.

Prospective passengers are advised to stay at home as roads to the airport are very busy, spokeswoman Caroline Nicholls said. Both terminals have been cleared while police search the buildings for any suspect packages.
